max_watches.description: Maximum number of inotify watches per user. Set to 0 to use system-imposed limit (recommended).

allow_users.description: List of usernames allowed to use incron. If non-empty, only these users may access incron (whitelist mode).

deny_users.description: List of usernames explicitly denied incron access. Ignored if allow_users is non-empty.

use_syslog.description: Whether to send incron log messages to the system syslog service.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0 (errors only) to 3 (debug). Higher values increase log detail.

user_table_dir.description: Directory where per-user inotify table files are stored.
